title: TC-TIB-024 — [Happy path] Customization info & public order API show "Label: <item>" for Additional Option GO
steps:
Preconditions: Two campaigns/artworks, one using an inline Additional Option GO and one using a category-sourced Additional Option GO

  1. Place a test order on each campaign, selecting one item on the Additional Option field
  2. Open the order's Customization info in the portal
  3. Check the public order/customization API response for the same order
expectedResult: Both the portal's Customization info and the public API response show a new "Label: <chosen item name>" line for the Additional Option field — for both the inline-sourced and category-sourced GO (previously this line was missing entirely).
actualResult:
Re-verified after root-cause fix. Original failure (order #4481) was caused by a test-data gap, not a product bug: both GO 986 (inline) and GO 987 (category-sourced) had an empty Option Title field (HTML input name form_label) in their Settings — this is the field that drives the "Label: " line.

Filled in Option Title (GO 986 = "Color", GO 987 = "Size") and saved. User placed a new test order on campaign 2730 afterward and confirmed the label now appears correctly (e.g. "Color: " / "Size: ") in the order's customization data.

Note: PO/DEV confirm — should "Option Title" be a required field for Additional Option GOs going forward? Right now leaving it empty silently produces no label line at all instead of erroring, which is what caused the original false failure.
